name: Chicken Thighs with Rice
steps: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Sear in olive oil 4 min per side.
Sauté onion and garlic, add rice and broth.
Return chicken, cover, simmer 20 min.

name: Beef Stir Fry
steps: Slice beef thin. Cook rice.
Stir fry beef in hot oil 2 min, set aside.
Stir fry broccoli and garlic.
Return beef, add soy sauce and ginger, toss.
Serve over rice.

name: Pork Chops with Apple
steps: Sear pork chops in butter 3 min per side.
Sauté onion and apple slices.
Roast potatoes at 400 F 25 min.
Serve chops over potato with apple pan sauce.

name: Salmon Teriyaki
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic for teriyaki sauce.
Marinate salmon 15 min.
Pan-fry salmon 4 min per side, baste with sauce.
Serve over rice.

name: Veggie Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook pasta al dente.
Sauté garlic, zucchini, bell pepper in olive oil.
Add tomatoes, toss with pasta and parmesan.

name: Peanut Chicken Noodles
steps: Cook noodles. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, garlic.
Grill or pan-fry chicken, slice.
Toss noodles with sauce and chicken, garnish with green onions.

name: Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook quinoa, cool.
Dice cucumber, tomato, red onion.
Toss all with olive oil and lemon, top with feta.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, carrot in olive oil.
Brown ground beef, add tomato sauce, simmer 20 min.
Serve over spaghetti with parmesan.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Grill or pan-fry chicken breast, slice.
Toss romaine with caesar dressing, lemon, parmesan.
Top with chicken and croutons.

name: Vegetable Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger.
Add curry powder, tomato, chickpeas.
Pour in coconut milk, simmer 15 min.
Stir in spinach, serve over rice.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Toss chicken and veg with olive oil, garlic, paprika.
Spread on sheet pan, roast 400 F 30 min.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef, drain fat.
Add taco seasoning and water, simmer 5 min.
Serve in taco shells with cheese, lettuce, tomato, sour cream.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
steps: Cook pasta. Sauté garlic in butter and olive oil.
Add shrimp, cook 2 min per side.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice, parsley and parmesan.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice. Scramble eggs, set aside.
Stir fry chicken, add rice, soy sauce, peas, carrots.
Stir in eggs and green onions, drizzle sesame oil.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Roast tomatoes and garlic at 400 F 20 min.
Blend with sautéed onion, garlic and broth.
Stir in cream and basil, season to taste.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Vegetables
steps: Rub pork with mustard, garlic, rosemary.
Roast with vegetables at 425 F 25 min.
Rest 5 min, slice.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté onion and garlic. Add rice, toast 2 min.
Add wine, then broth ladle by ladle stirring constantly.
Fold in sautéed mushrooms, butter and parmesan.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with cumin.
Add beans, tomato, broth, simmer 20 min.
Blend half the soup, return to pot, serve with lime and sour cream.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Place salmon and asparagus on sheet pan.
Drizzle with olive oil, dot with butter, top with garlic, lemon and dill.
Bake 400 F 15 min.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices 30 min.
Grill chicken, cut into pieces.
Simmer onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomato sauce and cream.
Add chicken, serve over rice.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Slice beef thin. Cook rice.
Blanch broccoli. Stir fry beef 2 min.
Add broccoli, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, oyster sauce, toss.
Drizzle sesame oil, serve over rice.

name: Pasta Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti. Fry bacon and garlic.
Whisk eggs and parmesan.
Off heat, toss pasta with bacon and egg mixture, loosen with pasta water.

name: Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer chicken in broth with onion, carrot, celery 25 min.
Remove chicken, shred, return to pot.
Add noodles, cook 8 min, finish with parsley.

name: Shrimp Tacos
steps: Season and pan-fry shrimp 2 min per side.
Warm tortillas. Mix sour cream with lime.
Build tacos with shrimp, cabbage, avocado, cilantro and lime crema.

name: Ground Turkey Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook rice. Brown turkey with onion, garlic, seasoning.
Mix turkey with rice and tomato sauce, stuff into halved peppers.
Top with mozzarella, bake 375 F 30 min.

name: Vegetarian Chili
steps: Sauté onion, bell pepper, garlic.
Add chili powder, cumin, tomato, beans, corn.
Simmer 20 min, serve with sour cream or avocado.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni. Make cheese sauce with butter, flour, milk, cheddar.
Combine, top with breadcrumbs.
Bake 375 F 20 min until golden.

name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill chicken, slice.
Combine cucumber, tomato, olives, feta, red onion.
Dress with olive oil, lemon, oregano, top with chicken.

name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
steps: Rub pork with sugar, paprika, garlic.
Slow cook with onion 8 hours or oven 300 F 4 hours.
Shred, toss with BBQ sauce, serve on buns with coleslaw.

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles. Mix tuna, soup, milk, peas.
Combine with noodles, top with cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake 375 F 25 min.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, carrot with cumin and turmeric.
Add lentils, tomato, broth, simmer 25 min until soft.
Blend partially, finish with lemon juice.

name: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Grill and slice chicken. Sauté bell pepper and onion.
Layer tortilla with cheese, chicken, veg, fold.
Cook in pan 3 min per side, serve with sour cream and salsa.

name: Beef Chili
steps: Brown beef with onion, garlic.
Add chili powder, cumin, tomato, beans, broth.
Simmer 30 min, season to taste.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice. Scramble eggs, set aside.
Stir fry shrimp and garlic, add rice, soy sauce, peas, carrots.
Toss in eggs and green onions, finish with sesame oil.

name: Veggie Frittata
steps: Sauté veg in oven-safe pan.
Whisk eggs with feta, pour over veg.
Cook 3 min on stovetop, finish in 375 F oven 10 min.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring broth to boil with onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add chicken and potato, simmer 20 min.
Remove chicken, shred, return. Add herbs.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Cook penne. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Add tomato sauce, simmer 10 min.
Toss with pasta and parsley, top with parmesan.

name: Baked Chicken Breast
steps: Pound chicken to even thickness.
Rub with olive oil, garlic, paprika, Italian seasoning.
Bake 425 F 18 min, rest 5 min, drizzle with lemon.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burritos
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato 400 F 20 min.
Season beans with cumin and chili.
Wrap potato, beans, cheese in tortillas, bake or pan-fry seam side down.

name: Beef Stew
steps: Dredge beef in flour, brown in batches.
Sauté onion and garlic, add beef, broth, tomato paste, thyme.
Simmer covered 90 min, add potato and carrot, cook 30 more min.

name: Garlic Butter Tilapia
steps: Season tilapia. Pan-fry in olive oil 3 min per side.
Add butter and garlic, baste fish.
Finish with lemon and parsley.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in olive oil.
Add tomato, beans, broth, simmer 15 min.
Add pasta, cook until tender. Serve with parmesan.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, seasoning.
Roll into balls, bake 400 F 18 min.
Simmer in tomato sauce, serve over spaghetti.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
steps: Cook rice and steam broccoli.
Pan-fry chicken, glaze with soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger sauce.
Serve over rice with broccoli, garnish with sesame and green onions.

name: Minestrone
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic.
Add tomato, broth, beans, zucchini, simmer 15 min.
Add pasta, cook 8 min. Stir in spinach.

name: BBQ Pork Ribs
steps: Rub ribs with sugar, paprika, garlic, onion, pepper.
Bake 300 F 2.5 hours wrapped in foil.
Brush with BBQ sauce, broil 5 min to caramelise.

name: Caprese Pasta
steps: Cook pasta. Halve tomatoes, cube mozzarella.
Warm garlic and tomatoes in olive oil.
Toss with pasta, mozzarella, basil, balsamic drizzle.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken and vegetables. Make roux with butter and flour.
Add broth and milk, simmer until thick.
Mix in chicken and veg, pour into crust, top with crust, bake 375 F 35 min.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice. Scramble eggs.
Stir fry garlic, add rice, soy sauce, peas, carrots.
Toss in eggs, green onions, sesame oil.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, grill or pan-fry.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger with spices, add tomato sauce.
Add butter and cream, simmer, add chicken. Serve over rice.

name: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix salmon, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, parsley, lemon, mayo.
Form patties, pan-fry in olive oil 3 min per side.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Roast Beef with Potatoes
steps: Sear roast in oil on all sides.
Add veg and broth to roasting pan.
Roast 325 F until 145 F internal. Rest 15 min, slice.

name: Spicy Pork Ramen
steps: Simmer broth with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, gochujang.
Slice roasted pork belly.
Cook ramen noodles, soft-boil eggs.
Assemble bowls with noodles, broth, pork, egg, green onions.

name: Caprese Chicken
steps: Sear chicken breast 4 min per side.
Top with tomato and mozzarella, cover until cheese melts.
Drizzle with balsamic, garnish with basil.

name: Bean and Vegetable Stir Fry
steps: Cook rice.
Stir fry garlic and vegetables in hot oil.
Season with soy sauce, drizzle sesame oil, serve over rice.

name: Clam Chowder
steps: Fry bacon, sauté onion and celery in butter.
Add flour, then broth and potatoes, simmer 15 min.
Add clams and cream, heat through without boiling.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Cook and shred chicken with onion, garlic, cumin.
Fill tortillas with chicken and cheese, roll.
Pour enchilada sauce over, top with cheese.
Bake 375 F 25 min. Serve with sour cream.

name: Tofu Stir Fry
steps: Press and cube tofu, pan-fry until golden.
Stir fry garlic, ginger, vegetables.
Add tofu and soy sauce, toss, drizzle sesame oil, serve over rice.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint Sauce
steps: Marinate chops in garlic, rosemary, olive oil, lemon 30 min.
Grill or pan-sear 3 min per side.
Make mint sauce: blend mint, lemon, olive oil. Serve with roasted potatoes.

name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash bananas, whisk in eggs and milk.
Add flour and baking powder, mix gently.
Cook in buttered pan 2 min per side. Serve with maple syrup.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Mix honey, garlic, soy sauce, olive oil, paprika.
Coat drumsticks, marinate 30 min.
Bake 400 F 40 min, basting twice.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
steps: Cook shells. Mix ricotta, spinach, egg, garlic, seasoning.
Fill shells, place in baking dish over tomato sauce.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan, bake 375 F 30 min.
